Build a Todo app in a single self-contained HTML file. Requirements:
- Add new todos
- Mark todos as complete (strikethrough)
- Delete todos
- Filter: All / Active / Completed
- Persist to localStorage

Deliver only the HTML file with JS, CSS, HTML. Use file name "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html"

{"path": "todo_openrouter-moonshotai-kimi-k3_01.html", "edit_description": "Create a NEW single self-contained HTML file implementing a complete Todo app (HTML + CSS + JS in one file, no external dependencies).

Functional requirements (all mandatory):
1. Add new todos: an input field and an "Add" button; pressing Enter in the input also adds. Empty/whitespace-only todos are ignored. Input is cleared after adding.
2. Mark todos as complete: each todo item has a checkbox; checking it toggles the completed state and the todo text gets a strikethrough (CSS text-decoration: line-through) and dimmed color.
3. Delete todos: each item has a delete button (✕) that removes the todo.
4. Filters: three filter buttons — All / Active / Completed. Clicking one filters the visible list and highlights the active filter button. Filter state is kept in a JS variable (does not need to persist).
5. Persist to localStorage: todos array (objects with id, text, completed) saved under a key like 'todos' on every change (add/toggle/delete); on page load, read and render from localStorage (handle missing/invalid JSON gracefully).

Structure & UX details:
- Header with an app title (e.g. "Todo App").
- A footer/status line showing the count of remaining active items (e.g. "3 item(s) left").
- Show an empty-state message (e.g. "No todos here") when the filtered list is empty.
- Use textContent or proper escaping when rendering todo text to avoid HTML injection.
- Re-render the list from the state array on every change (single render function).

Styling (embedded <style> in <head>):
- Clean modern look: centered card layout (max-width ~500px), system font stack, light background, subtle box-shadow, rounded corners.
- Styled filter buttons with an .active class for the selected filter.
- Hover state on delete buttons.
- Responsive enough for mobile widths.

Script (embedded <script> at end of <body>): vanilla JS only, no libraries. Include a brief HTML comment at top of file identifying it as a self-contained Todo app."}
